title: Cinematics
summary: Big moments play as short scenes. The game waits while they do.
text:
Some moments play as a **cinematic**: the camera moves over the world, with titles, voices and music, while the game waits for you. Arriving in a new region usually opens with one, and a new colony opens with the **landing**: the seed-probe burns down through the dust, folds its shell open and becomes your Command Core.

Press Esc or tap **Skip** to skip one. Nothing in your colony moves while it plays, so you never lose time to watching.
